A `SOLID` label means the stated measurement is artifact-backed, not that independent pretraining-seed replication exists. There is **no pretraining-seed replication** in this programme; all multi-seed ep30 anatomy/envelope results are probe-seed technical repeats on one encoder per arm.

## tissue-class-relations
